Path 1, deliveryGOALS §1.1

Argo CD

The GitOps controller we already run. The work is making it converge, not choosing it.

WHAT IT IS

A CNCF Graduated controller that continuously reconciles clusters to what is declared in Git, with a UI, RBAC, multi-cluster targets and sync waves.

WHAT SETS IT APART

Versus Flux: a first-class UI and ApplicationSets for fleets; Flux is lighter and more composable but has no UI. The 3.x line added a resources explorer and ApplicationSet views.

WHERE WE STAND

Already ours. Turn on auto-sync with self-heal, and write the upgrade ticket to the current 3.x line. ⚠️ Confirm the exact version against the release notes.
